name: Stolen Silver
summary: At the Crossroads, a strongbox of Horde silver has gone missing from the guard tower. Sunscale raptors carried the coins to their nests at the Raptor Grounds south of Ratchet.

sections.title: A Beastly Heist
sections.body: Sunscale raptors carried a strongbox of silver from the Crossroads guard tower. The coins were meant as pay for the garrison guards. The raptors dragged the lockbox to their communal nests at the Raptor Grounds, south of Ratchet. Gazrog and the other overseers cannot explain why the predators took it. The theft leaves them wondering whether the raptors prize shiny things or possess a cunning beyond that of ordinary wild beasts.

faq.answer: The Stolen Silver is a heavy lockbox of coins meant to pay the Crossroads guards. Raptors stole it from the guard tower and carried it to their nesting grounds.

faq.q: Why did raptors steal a lockbox of coins?
faq.answer: Even Gazrog cannot explain why the raptors took the lockbox. They may have been drawn to its shiny metal, or their unusual cunning may have led them to carry it deep into their lair.
The raptors took the lockbox to the Raptor Grounds, a rugged canyon of nests south of Ratchet in the eastern Barrens.

faq.q: Who is looking for the Stolen Silver?
faq.answer: Gazrog, an orc stationed at the Crossroads, is looking for the chest. The silver is a full month's pay for the outpost's hard-pressed defenders.

angles.text: The Crossroads is the heart of the Horde's presence in the Barrens. Recovering the pay keeps the local grunts fed, paid, and ready to hold the line against centaur and Alliance incursions.
